notes.title: Update for Aug. 2025
notes.notes:
Welcome, Bandeirantes!

New update includes:

- Unreal Engine update to version 5.6 with performance improvements.
- Death screen and translation fixes.
- Menu bugs fixed.
- Added sound when drinking river water.
- Fixed game start music.

Stay tuned for new updates soon.

Argo Games Team.

notes.title: New Update!
notes.notes:
Hi there explorers!

This is the first Build with new features!
Here is the list:
- You can now drink water.
- Add torches around the camp for night time play.
- Minor adjustments on thirst and hunger.
- Minor bug fixes.

Keep exploring!


Argo Games Team.
